page.overview:
Who is Deepa?

Deepa was a blood-thirsty sociopath capable of killing people without any hesitation or true provocation. Due to his inhumanity and atrociousness, he wasn't understood by others. He was very battle-crazed, enjoying a good challenge if he could find it. Sadistic by nature, Deepa treated his target as prey for a hunt, looking at them as beneath him. He relished in the fear and pain he could inflict on others, even toying with them, such as pretending to be affected by his enemies' attacks, giving them false hope, only to end his façade and enjoy the expressions of confusion and terror of his opponents afterwards.

Apparently a gourmet, he enjoyed trying as many different flavours as he could in the world. Due to his deranged nature, he had become a cannibal, desiring to taste the blood and flesh of his enemies as it intrigues him. At the same time, Deepa was a very random man. Whereas at one moment he would slaughter people on impulse, another moment he was remarkably calm and saw no need in killing someone who couldn't fight back. His greatest wish was to taste the fruit of the God Tree itself; which he believed to have the purest flavour in the world; upon seeing the artificial Tree that he and Victor conspired to recreate being incinerated, he lost his composure and flew into a violent rage at Team 7 for losing his chance to taste the fruit.

A very independent man, he cared little about other people's view of him, openly admitting that he knew his allies had little trust in him. He was very vain, viewing his refined-carbon form as the most beautiful thing in the world and thought himself invincible. Determined to keep himself a mystery, Deepa was committed to killing anyone who was not an ally once they see his face, but he nonetheless acted somewhat disrespectful towards his allies, such as Victor. Despite his sadistic nature, however, Deepa had a sense of honour, offering to spare Omoi's life should he reveal the location of the Hashirama Cell, and kept his word after Omoi's subordinates caved in, although in a twisted turn of events, killed Kakui and Marui instead as they weren't part of his promise. He also had a sense of responsibility, putting his mission before his personal joy.

Deepa apparently had a sense of humour, however morbid he may be, as Isshiki Ōtsutsuki noted how Deepa would make him laugh, even if not openly.
